audience: marketers and small businesses who send email campaigns with Mail Blaze

useCases.title: Count subscribers on each mailing list
useCases.text: The AI lists your mailing lists with subscriber counts and opens one list for its settings, fields and segments.

useCases.title: Compare opens, clicks and bounces of campaigns
useCases.text: The AI reads report summaries of up to 50 campaigns, with sent, opens, clicks, bounces and unsubscribes, and compares them for you.

useCases.title: Check if an address is subscribed and what it opened
useCases.text: The AI finds a subscriber by email in a list and reads that person's email activity, with sends, opens, clicks and bounces.

useCases.title: Add subscribers or update their details
useCases.text: The AI adds one subscriber, or up to 100 in one request, to a mailing list, and updates a subscriber's name or custom fields. The list may send a confirmation email.

useCases.title: Unsubscribe or resubscribe a person
useCases.text: The AI unsubscribes a subscriber who asked to stop, or resubscribes someone who asked to be added back.

useCases.title: Schedule a campaign or send a transactional email
useCases.text: The AI schedules a campaign from a template to a list or segment, or sends one email to one recipient. Both leave once sent and cannot be recalled.
